purpose: Recover preferred magnitude-source metadata required before regional/time-varying seismic magnitude-completeness estimation.

query.saturation_split: recursive time split; raw saturated responses retained
query.split_boundary_overlap: deduplicate by event id; conflicting duplicate metadata is a hard failure

reconciliation.missing_mag_source: UNRESOLVED; never infer from network code
reconciliation.source_mixture: requires stratification; do not pool across sources
reconciliation.magnitude_type_missing: UNRESOLVED; do not pool missing magnitude scales
reconciliation.magnitude_type_mixture: requires stratification by magnitude type; do not pool across types

downstream_gate: Mc(t,region) candidate analysis may start only after every accepted event is reconciled and magSource and magType are present; stratify by both magnitude source and magnitude type. Never infer magSource from network code.
non_goals: No Mc acceptance or null-model fitting in this provenance-recovery stage
